sections.title: The instrument takes -on/-en/-ön
sections.content: To say you play an instrument, use -on/-en/-ön — the same "on" case from Unit 6 — together with játszik: zongorán játszik ("plays the piano"), gitáron játszik ("plays the guitar"). Hungarian is fully consistent here, even where English switches between "play the piano" and "play on the piano".

items.english: I've been playing the piano for twenty years.

items.spanish: A testvérem gitáron játszik a zenekarban.
items.english: My sibling plays guitar in the band.

sections.content: -val/-vel ("with") is for a tool you use ON something else, like vág egy késsel ("cuts with a knife"). An instrument isn't used on anything — it's the surface the music happens on, which is why it takes -on/-en/-ön instead.
